metaTitle: Sliding Glass Door Repair Boca Raton | Multi-Panel Doors
description: Sliding glass door repair in Boca Raton, from multi-slide and pocketing doors to the wind rules and the city's permit checklist when a door is replaced.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in Boca Raton
subline: Boca Raton sits outside the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone but inside the storm rules, and multi-panel glass doors bring their own roller and sill problems.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in Boca Raton is usually rollers, tracks and locks, and on multi-slide doors it's often one panel that needs work. A replacement needs a city permit with product approvals on site for inspection. Palm Beach County is outside the HVHZ, but expect impact glass or approved shutters on a new door.
faqHeading: Boca Raton questions about big doors and permits
closing: Send a photo of the whole door from inside and a close-up of the panel that drags, and tell us how many panels move. We'll tell you what we'd check first.

faqs.q: Why are door rules stricter in Deerfield Beach than in Boca Raton?
faqs.a: Because the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone stops at the county line. The Florida Building Code applies it only to Broward and Miami-Dade, so a new door in Deerfield Beach needs an HVHZ approval. In Boca Raton, a Florida product approval for use outside the HVHZ is the normal route.

faqs.q: Is Boca Raton in a wind-borne debris region?
faqs.a: Expect it to be. Palm Beach County's Building Division says all of unincorporated Palm Beach County is in the wind-borne debris region, where glazed openings need impact glass or approved protection. The city's building division confirms the requirement for your address when you apply for a permit.

faqs.q: What paperwork has to be at the house for a Boca Raton door inspection?
faqs.a: The product approval or Miami-Dade NOA for every door being installed. The city's over-the-counter affidavit says missing approvals can fail the inspection and bring re-inspection fees. Each installed door also needs its own scheduled inspection.

faqs.q: Can one panel of a multi-slide door be fixed without touching the rest?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Each moving panel on a multi-slide door rides on its own rollers with its own height adjustment, so one sagging panel can be lifted, adjusted or given new rollers alone. If the interlock where panels meet has shifted, the neighboring panel may need a small adjustment too.

faqs.q: Why does Boca Raton ask for water testing on some new doors?
faqs.a: Because the building code requires it for doors that don't meet certain exceptions. The city's window and door schedule says doors not meeting exceptions 1 and 2 of Florida Building Code sections 1709.5.1 and R609.3 must be tested for water infiltration. The door's product documents show which applies.
